Tara (CS): Quick weekly Summit-Bridge health check. Usage steady, embed spend up 7%, noticed two p99 spikes on /completion non-stream yesterday. Dropping compact route/model p95/p99 + notes.

Ruth (Solutions): thanks 99can you paste the numbers so we can recommend defaults for staging?

Tara (CS): rolling 7d aggregates (ms, err%, req/day):

```
route    model     mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat    t5-large  streaming    240  780  0.27  16k
/chat    t5-large  non-stream   430 1300 0.95   3.2k
/comp    gpt-lite  sync         700 2100 2.4    4.2k
/embed   nano      streaming     52  140  0.03  59k
/rerank  llama2    non-stream   1080 2850 3.4   820
```

Ethan (SRE): rerank tail correlates with large batch reranks hitting the dedicated pool. We saw 3 OOMs at 02:58 UTC.

Sam (Customer): we had a background job that retried 4x and caused a visible slow down for a minute.

Ruth (Solutions): Observations: streaming reduces p95 ~45% and tightens p99 for /chat. Recommend: default stream=true for chat, enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts, cap rerank batch tokens to 2k and add early-exit.

Tara (CS): Action items:
- Ethan: collect OOM traces and open incident if >=3 OOMs in 24h (assigned)
- Ruth: draft a short runbook for batching caps + backoff and share by Tue
- Tara: send cost cap options for embed to Sam

OpsBot: Created ticket CH-2456-88 "Summit-Bridge rerank OOMs + retry amplification" assigned to Ethan.

Ruth (Solutions): quick curl to enable streaming for chat in staging:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"t5-large","stream":true}'
```

Sam (Customer): I'll flip streaming in staging tonight and run a synthetic p99 test. Please include an embed budget throttle option in dollars.

Tara (CS): noted 9Next check-in Thursday 9am PT. Thanks!
